programme.title: Mentes criminales
programme.desc: Al encontrar un cuerpo en Atlanta cubierto de rasguños. La UAC cree que esta muerte y posteriores homicidios podrían estar relacionados con una persona que tiene un trastorno obsesivo de la piel.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Por orden del Gobernador de Virginia, un escéptico Gibbs se ve obligado a reunirse con un asesino en serie al que ayudó a condenar una década antes bajo el pretexto de que el asesino le dirá a Gibbs dónde escondió cadáveres desaparecidos.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs y el equipo son llamados cuando un hombre recientemente fallecido es encontrado encerrado en una tumba de la época de la Guerra Civil. El cadáver es el de un sargento desaparecido que, según Ducky, fue enterrado vivo.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Cuando un contramaestre es brutalmente tiroteado en la autopista, Gibbs y el equipo descubren que el agente llevaba una doble vida.

programme.title: NCIS
programme.desc: Gibbs y el equipo investigan el asesinato de la esposa de un marine que parece haber sido difundido por Internet.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: Sin salida
programme.desc: Un hombre emocionalmente perturbado retiene a Maria como rehén a punta de pistola en una sala de interrogatorios. Danny debe cumplir sus demandas para protegerla. Mientras, Frank enfrenta un dilema personal y moral.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: Gajes del oficio
programme.desc: Erin se siente conmocionada por un asaltante que irrumpe en su apartamento. Jamie y Eddie descubren una bomba en el apartamento de una anciana. Frank investiga una organización benéfica sospechosa.

programme.desc: Eddie se embarca en su primera operación encubierta para investigar una red de secuestros que se dirige a mujeres jóvenes. Frank ayuda a una mujer a reunirse con el recluso que mató a su familia.

programme.title: Blue Bloods, en español: Todo depende del cristal
programme.desc: Frank se enfrenta a una periodista que se niega a revelar su fuente, aunque admite haber cometido un asesinato. Danny se empareja con un adolescente problemático en un programa de la policía para ayudarlo a tomar mejores decisiones.

programme.title: Mentes criminales

programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: On July 23rd, 2016, Terence Crawford fought Viktor Postol for the WBO and WBC World Super Lightweight Titles at the MGM Grand in Las Vegas. Scoring two knockdowns, Crawford dominated the fight, earning a much deserved unanimous decision victory.

programme.title: Terence Crawford vs Yuriorkis Gamboa

programme.title: Thomas Hearns vs Roberto Duran

programme.desc: Cat begins dating Tori's ex-boyfriend, Danny (Matt Angel) and Tori becomes jealous. Meanwhile, Trina convinces Robbie, Andre, Jade and Beck to indulge their feet in callus-eating fish that she's been buying from some stranger.

programme.title: Victorious: Sleepover at Sikowitz's
programme.desc: Sikowitz invites the gang to have a sleepover at his house in order to teach them a lesson in method acting.

programme.title: Victorious: The Wood
programme.desc: The kids are excited to hear that they'll be the stars of a new reality show being filmed at Hollywood Arts. Meanwhile, Trina and Robbie are forced to work at The Grub Truck after injuring Festus.

programme.title: Victorious: The Great Ping-Pong Scam
programme.desc: Tori discovers that her friends have been secretly going to a fancy restaurant instead of playing in an annual ping pong tournament.

programme.title: Victorious: Wok Star
programme.desc: Tori agrees to help Jade find a theater to perform a play Jade wrote. But when the sponsor demands changes that will ruin Jade's play, Tori has to make things right before opening night.

programme.title: Victorious: Survival of the Hottest
programme.desc: A heat wave hits LA and the gang heads for the beach in Beck's RV. But once there, they find themselves trapped inside the RV as the temperature rises. Oblivious, Cat parties it up with some cute boys.

programme.title: Victorious: Wi-Fi in the Sky
programme.desc: Tori's flight home is delayed, leaving her no time to finish a school project with her friends. She attempts to get the work done with them over video chat, but things keep getting in the way.

programme.title: Victorious: Freak the Freak Out
programme.desc: Tori's friends sing at a local karaoke club and end up competing with a pair of stuck-up girls who are regular performers there. Competing with those girls proves to be more difficult than they expect, since one of the girls' father owns the club.

programme.title: Victorious: Beck Falls for Tori
programme.desc: Tori auditions for a role in a movie. But after exaggerating on her resume, she gets hired as a stunt double. When Tori finds out her stunt is falling off a building, she's not sure she can do it.

programme.title: Victorious: Helen Back Again
programme.desc: When Principal Eikner leaves Hollywood Arts, the school hires a new principal who makes all the students re-audition in order to keep their spots. Who will get kicked out?

programme.title: Victorious: Tori Gets Stuck
programme.desc: Tori Gets Stuck: Tori is excited when she gets cast as the lead in the school play, but she has to deal with her very unhappy understudy… Jade. Tori has to avoid Jade's constant sabotage so she can perform on opening night.

programme.title: Victorious: Tori Tortures Teacher
programme.desc: The kids take Sikowitz to the theater to celebrate his ten-year teaching anniversary, but the play's subject sends Sikowitz into a deep depression. Tori must cheer him up.

programme.title: Victorious: Jade Gets Crushed
programme.desc: Andre spends time with Jade working on a song and develops a crush on her. Tori tries to help him get over his crush, but nothing seems to work, and Andre has trouble keeping his feelings a secret.

programme.title: Victorious: Who Did it to Trina?
programme.desc: Trina stars in Tori's directorial debut, and there is a big accident on opening night. Lane wants to find out what went wrong. Everyone thinks it was an equipment malfunction, maybe it's sabotage.

programme.title: Victorious: Beggin' On Your Knees
programme.desc: Beggin' On Your Knees: The Full Moon Jam is coming up. The cutest boy in school wants to perform a duet with Tori, but she finds out he has a reputation. Is Tori just having trust issues, or is this guy bad news?

programme.title: Victorious: Ice Cream for Ke$ha
programme.desc: Tori has to be Trina's assistant for a month. The only way Trina will call off the bet is if Tori wins a private Ke$ha concert. Tori's friends try to save Tori and hopefully score a Ke$ha concert!

programme.title: Victorious: Prom Wrecker
programme.desc: Tori rallies the gang into having prom at Hollywood Arts, but the event ruins Jade's art project, and now she's out for revenge. Can Tori throw a successful prom, with Jade aiming to bring the whole dance down?

programme.title: Victorious: Terror on Cupcake Street
programme.desc: The kids have to build a float fast. They only have a night to drive the float to the parade. When the float breaks down in a bad neighborhood, can the kids recover and save their chance to be on TV?

programme.title: Met 'n Huppel In Die Stap
programme.desc: 'S15/E16'. In die eerste van drie aflewerings oor die Limpopo provinsie, hoor ons van uitgrawings by die antieke stad, Mapungubwe, op die grens van Zimbabwe en Botswana.

programme.title: Renboogrant
programme.desc: 'S1/E45 - Een Sprong'. Kersfees bring verrassings vir die Brinks. Dave en Shani se afspraak ontaard in 'n angswekkende situasie, terwyl Chris se besluite groter gevolge het as wat enige iemand kon verwag.

programme.title: Koortjies Met Elwira Standili
programme.desc: 'S4/E2'. Vanaand praat ons oor heling n seer kinderjare. Ouma Sarie se Moses Williams deel sy storie. Dan gee pastoor en berader Anzelle Jacobs raad en Jehan Quota sing ons harte aan die brand.

programme.title: Toks & Tjops
programme.desc: 'S16/E28'. Die Bulls en Stormers oorheers die derby's in laas naweek se URC. Die oud Bok-breier Jake White is Fiji se nuwe afrigter en Cameron Hanekom hou aan bendruk, asook Vaatjie met sy braai-bolognese.

programme.title: Musiekvideo's

programme.title: Die Boodskap

programme.title: Binnelanders
programme.desc: 'S15/E96'. Annetjie maak haar hart teenoor Elise oop. Joe raak paniekerig oor sy opsies, en Louis het 'n voorstel wanneer Hannah se eerste skooldag aanbreek.

programme.title: Binnelanders
programme.desc: 'S15/E97'. Net wanneer Naomi dink dit gaan beter met Hannah, ontdek sy dat Hannah by die skool weggeloop het. Rudolf vermoed onraad wanneer sekere dokumente aan die lig gebring word.

programme.title: Binnelanders
programme.desc: 'S15/E98'. Rudolf verras vir Nicolette. Elise beraam planne om van Annetjie se erfgoed ontslae te raak, en Louis se vermoedens oor Hannah word deur die skool bevestig.

programme.title: Binnelanders
programme.desc: 'S15/E99'. Anya besluit om die waarheid met Joe te deel. Louis maak 'n deurbraak met Hannah, en Annetjie bereik 'n belangrike keerpunt.

programme.title: Binnelanders
programme.desc: 'S15/E100'. Joe konfronteer vir Max. Nicolette praat Hannah moed in, en Uys oorreed Annetjie om haar susterskind te kontak.

programme.title: Suidooster
programme.desc: 'S12/E139'. Siya word toenemend getoets, terwyl Gary 'n geleentheid sien om Kate se mooi nuwe huurder se guns te wen. Bridgette begin twyfel oor haar wraakplan.

programme.title: Suidooster
programme.desc: 'S12/E140'. Bridgette speel uiteindelik oop kaarte met Lee-Ann. Mike is op 'n missie om 'n swendelaar uit te vang terwyl Elzette met vuur speel.

programme.title: Suidooster
programme.desc: 'S12/E141'. Siya se skuldgevoelens begin hom inhaal, terwyl Elzette 'n ferm besluit neem. Intussen stuur Kate se nuwe huurder haar bloeddruk onwetend die hoogte in.

programme.title: Suidooster
programme.desc: 'S12/E142'. Gary wil vir Claire uitvat vir ete terwyl Mike 'n opwindende aktiwiteit soek vir die renie wat hy moet rel. Justin is uitstedig en Elzette is alleen by die huis.

programme.title: Suidooster
programme.desc: 'S12/E143'. Gary maak 'n plan om die soort man te word waarvan Claire hou, terwyl Mike vrede maak met 'n vervelige renie. Siya probeer sterk staan nadat hy iets onbesonne gedoen het.

programme.title: Skemergrond
programme.desc: 'S3/E61'. Rynard se o dwaal. Genie konfronteer vir Ruan. Haylee is geskok wanneer sy uitvind wat Christine beplan. Wayne druk Jasmine en Winnie om die verlede in die gesig te staar.

programme.title: Skemergrond
programme.desc: 'S3/E62'. Wayne en Ragel delf dieper in die oorsprong van Jasmine en Winnie se konflik. Ruan vertel 'n wit leuentjie wat groot nagevolge kan h. Christine doen iets wat Rynard skok.

programme.title: Skemergrond
programme.desc: 'S3/E63'. Ragel en Wayne stel 'n ultimatum aan Jasmine en Winnie. Rynard lig Lily in oor Christine se planne op hulle troudag. Lily probeer vir Amber bewys dat sy vir Genie bo Ruan gekies het.

programme.title: Skemergrond
programme.desc: 'S3/E64'. Jasmine deel haar onsekerheid oor die plan, maar besluit om voort te gaan n Rynard haar paai. Christine betrap vir Lily en Rynard op Onregsfontein.

programme.title: Die Kantoor

programme.desc: Kaalgat Karel vertel die storie van Karel Venter (Francois Jacobs), 'n dertigjarige kaalnaeler, wat die opwinding en aandag wat hy by sportgeleenthede kry geniet!
